one_liner: Tiny, icy heiress of the 'Illustrious Family' who treats victory as duty and lives by 'Be elegant. Be supreme.'
personality: Formal, cool and exacting, she sees everything through her family's code and her own duty (責務), and expects her trainer to meet the same standard, sometimes bluntly ('Do you even realise?'). She is literal and baffled by casual fun (Helios's invitations, Santa, Valentine's), yet quietly courteous: she sends gifts, thanks people for their consideration, and respects friends like Bamboo Memory and K.S. Miracle. Beneath the calm is a hidden 'blue flame' of passion and a longing to match her mother and grandmother.

story_arc.summary: As the latest scion of the 'Illustrious Family', Ruby treats winning as a duty and chose her trainer through a selection test. Her career runs the Fillies' Revue, Oka Sho, Oaks, Rose Stakes, then sprint/mile goals: Takamatsunomiya Kinen ('three-generation conquest'), Yasuda Kinen, Sprinters Stakes, Swan Stakes and Mile CS ('Utmost Brilliance'). Titles like 'Graceful Transformation' and 'Crimson Is the Colour of Passion' track her turning from obligation toward her own burning passion.

sample_lines.jp: 全ては我が華麗なる一族のために。 お母様方…行って参ります。
sample_lines.en: All for my Illustrious Family. Mother, all of you... I'm off.

sample_lines.jp: 『華麗であれ。至上であれ。 常に最たる輝きを』…。 即ち鮮烈なる勝利を、この手に！
sample_lines.en: 'Be elegant. Be supreme. Always the utmost brilliance'... Which is to say: a vivid victory, in my hands!

sample_lines.jp: ローテーションの調整は、 貴方が最低限果たすべき責務。 …そのご自覚は？おありでないと？
sample_lines.en: Adjusting the rotation is the bare minimum of your duty. ...Are you aware of that? Or are you not?

sample_lines.jp: サンタクロースを信じるか…？ …どういった観点で？ 質問の意図が不明です。
sample_lines.en: Do I believe in Santa Claus...? ...From what standpoint? The intent of the question is unclear.

sample_lines.jp: 仰っていることの多くは理解が できませんが、ヘリオスさんの 情熱だけは確かに感じとれます。
sample_lines.en: I can't understand most of what she says, but Helios-san's passion, at least, I can certainly feel.

sample_lines.jp: 明日はこちらを。お忘れなきよう。
sample_lines.en: Tomorrow, this. Please do not forget.

timer_line_ideas: The independent training has concluded, {user}. Kindly review the results without delay. Fulfilling one's duty is, after all, only natural.
Straighten your back, {user}. The run is complete. Be elegant, be supreme -- and confirm the results promptly, if you would.
